Sub Setup()
Dim f As Object,g As Object
ActiveSheet.Name="Data"
Set f=Range("A2:A5").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue

g.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbGreen
f.Priority=9
End Sub

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then

Else
P=CStr(v)
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function ReadWitness() As String
Dim f As Object,s As String
Worksheets("Data").Activate
s="owner=["
For Each f In Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & TypeName(f) & ":" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ":p=" & CStr(f.Priority) & ":color=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & "|"
Next
s=s & "];slots=["
For Each f In Worksheets("Witness").Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & f.AppliesTo.Address & ":" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & "|"
Next
ReadWitness=s & "]"
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim witness As Worksheet,f As Object
Set witness=Worksheets.Add(After:=Worksheets(Worksheets.Count))
witness.Name="Witness"
Set f=witness.Range("A1:A2").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbMagenta
Set f=witness.Range("C1:C2").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbYellow
Probe=ReadWitness()
End Function
